headline: Mortgages Are Getting Harder to Obtain: Banks Shift Funds to Tech and the Property Market Bids Farewell to the 'Arbitrage Era' - Real Estate - Liberty Times
summary: Experts say Taiwan's banks are restructuring lending, with funds shifting from construction and development firms to high-tech companies. Central bank credit controls have made mortgages harder to obtain.
why: Bank lending mix determines credit flow to property developers and high-tech firms, affecting the real-estate cycle and bank loan growth.
